There was once a poor shoemaker. <break time="0.8s" /> He worked hard, but he became very poor. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon he had leather for only one pair of shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> In the evening, he cut the leather for the shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> I will finish the shoes in the morning, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he said a prayer and went to sleep. <break time="0.8s" /> In the morning, the shoes were on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> They were all done, and every stitch was perfect.

옛날 옛적에. <break time="0.8s" /> 가난한 구두장이가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 열심히 일했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그는 아주 가난해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 그에게는 가죽이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두 딱 한 켤레를 만들 만큼만. <break time="0.8s" /> 저녁에 그는 가죽을 잘랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두를 만들려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두를 다 만들어야지. <break time="0.8s" /> 아침에 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그는 기도를 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 잠이 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아침에 보니. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두가 탁자 위에 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두는 다 만들어져 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 바늘땀 하나하나가 완벽했다.

The shoemaker. <break time="0.8s" /> Was very surprised. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon a customer. <break time="0.8s" /> Came into the shop. <break time="0.8s" /> He liked the shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> And paid more than usual. <break time="0.8s" /> With the money. <break time="0.8s" /> The shoemaker bought leather. <break time="0.8s" /> For two pairs. <break time="0.8s" /> The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> Two pairs of shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> Were ready. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he bought leather. <break time="0.8s" /> For four pairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Every morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The new shoes were on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon the shoemaker was a rich man.

구두장이는. <break time="0.8s" /> 무척 놀랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 손님 한 명이. <break time="0.8s" /> 가게 안으로 들어왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 그 구두가 마음에 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 평소보다 더 많이 돈을 냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 돈으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두장이는 가죽을 샀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 두 켤레를 만들 만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음 날 아침. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두 두 켤레가. <break time="0.8s" /> 다 준비되어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그다음에 그는 가죽을 샀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 네 켤레를 만들 만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 아침마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 새 구두가 탁자 위에 놓여 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 구두장이는 부자가 되었다.

One evening before Christmas. <break time="0.8s" /> The shoemaker spoke to his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Let us stay up tonight. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> Then we can see. <break time="0.8s" /> Who is helping us. <break time="0.8s" /> They lit a candle. <break time="0.8s" /> And hid behind some clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> At midnight. <break time="0.8s" /> Two little men came in. <break time="0.8s" /> They were tiny. <break time="0.8s" /> And they had no clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> They sat at the table. <break time="0.8s" /> And sewed very fast. <break time="0.8s" /> When the shoes were done. <break time="0.8s" /> They ran away.

크리스마스를 앞둔 어느 날 저녁. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두장이가 아내에게 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 오늘 밤에는 자지 말고 깨어 있어 봅시다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러면 우리는 볼 수 있을 거예요. <break time="0.8s" /> 누가 우리를 돕고 있는지. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 촛불을 켰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 옷 뒤에 숨었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한밤중에. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 사람 두 명이 들어왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 아주 작았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 옷이 하나도 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 탁자에 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아주 빠르게 바느질했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 구두가 다 만들어지자. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 달려 나갔다.

The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The wife had an idea. <break time="0.8s" /> The little men made us rich. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> They have no clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> So they must be cold. <break time="0.8s" /> She made tiny clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> And he made tiny shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> That evening. <break time="0.8s" /> They put the presents. <break time="0.8s" /> On the table. <break time="0.8s" /> At midnight. <break time="0.8s" /> They found the clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> And put them on quickly. <break time="0.8s" /> They danced over the chairs. <break time="0.8s" /> And out the door. <break time="0.8s" /> They never came back. <break time="0.8s" /> But the shoemaker did well. <break time="0.8s" /> All his life.

The next morning, the wife had an idea. <break time="0.8s" /> The little men made us rich, she said. <break time="0.8s" /> They have no clothes, so they must be cold. <break time="0.8s" /> She made tiny clothes, and he made tiny shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> That evening, they put the presents on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> At midnight, they found the clothes and put them on quickly. <break time="0.8s" /> They danced over the chairs and out the door. <break time="0.8s" /> They never came back, but the shoemaker did well all his life.

다음 날 아침. <break time="0.8s" /> 아내에게 좋은 생각이 떠올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 사람들이 우리를 부자로 만들어 주었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아내가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 옷이 없어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러니 틀림없이 추울 거예요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아내는 아주 작은 옷을 만들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 아주 작은 구두를 만들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그날 저녁. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 선물을 놓았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 탁자 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 한밤중에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 그 옷을 발견했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 재빨리 옷을 입었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 의자를 넘으며 춤을 추었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 문밖으로 나갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 다시는 오지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 구두장이는 잘 지냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 평생 동안.
